Sometimes things don't work exactly correct, for example when all NSFW content is set to be hidden, it seems like it doesn't hide posts with NSFW in their title from showing up in /v/all. Yeah, they shouldn't be showing up there for the most part, but there are various factors that may allow them to show up, pretty much all of which do need to be addressed.

  1. A few days ago I overhead there was a bug that was actively being worked on and I'm not sure whether that has been resolved.

  2. Sometimes subverses that should be NSFW aren't and sometimes the subverse creator isn't around to fix the issue.

  3. Last I checked subverses don't have any good indication whether they're NSFW so often NSFW posts don't got labeled correctly.

  4. Sometimes people are new and don't know how Voat works, so they submit things incorrectly.

  5. It's theoretically possible that people are intentionally submitting posts incorrectly, but I don't think that's much of a factor.

  6. There's no button specifically designed to report such content. There is downvoating as well as a spam button, but the moderator might not understand that it was marked as spam because it wasn't labeld correctly, or the moderator might not be around. So really the best thing to do, other than hunting and reporting bugs, is to discuss it with the person who posted the content and possibly also the person in charge of the subverse if they're around. It's a bit bothersome to have to do that, but outside of hunting and reporting bugs, that really the most effective solution at this time. It may seem like there's endless uninformed users, but if lots of people discuss it, then it's not really an insurmountable problem.
